title: Terms, definitions and classification of plain bearings, Part II: Friction and wear
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 10260 (PART 2)) prescribes technical specifications, requirements, tolerances, and testing procedures for Terms, definitions and classification of plain bearings, Part II: Friction and wear.
clause_3_terminology: definitions and classification of plain bearings

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
